data.summary:
Anaplan Model Builder with 4+ years of experience in Anaplan development, model building, solution design, FP&A, workforce planning, headcount planning, expense planning, inventory planning, warranty planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, dashboard development, and enterprise planning.
